title: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
text: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion16/11/2026Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi ArabiaDar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, today announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million).The project will be developed on land acquired for a consideration of approximately USD 56 million, further strengthening Dar Global's presence in one of Saudi Arabia's key real estate markets. The acquisition forms part of Dar Global's programme to expand its Saudi Arabia portfolio by up to SAR 4 billion, and further land acquisitions will be announced shortly. On completion of the programme, the company's global development pipeline is expected to reach approximately USD 24 billion.The development is also set to introduce a new international luxury brand to Jeddah through an exclusive co-branded residential concept, further strengthening the city's luxury real estate offering. The expansion follows strong market demand for Dar Global's existing developments in Jeddah, including Trump Plaza and Padel Living, reflecting sustained appetite for high-quality, master-crafted residential and mixed-use developments among both local buyers and foreign investors taking advantage of the new property ownership laws.Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, commented: “Saudi Arabia remains one of our most vital growth markets, and Jeddah continues to demonstrate exceptional fundamentals. The success of our existing developments reinforces our confidence in the market and underpins our commitment to delivering world-class residences in the Kingdom. With buyers from 61 nationalities already investing in our Saudi portfolio, we are witnessing accelerating international confidence in the country's real estate sector. This new development marks another significant milestone in our global expansion strategy.”This expanding international participation highlights the Kingdom's rising appeal as a premier destination for global real estate capital, bolstered by comprehensive regulatory reforms and the transformative momentum of Saudi Vision 2030.Further details regarding the development, including its architectural concept, residential offerings, and official launch date, will be unveiled in due course.Share ALL ARTICLES.

title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
text: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate26/10/2026Dubai, United Arab EmiratesDar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai.Operating independently from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) under regulatory oversight by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), DGCP connects global private wealth and institutional capital with prime real estate assets. As part of this cross-border mandate, and with Dubai continuing to attract sustained international capital inflows as a premier wealth and business hub, DGCP is exploring the potential for a dedicated Dubai-focused real estate opportunities fund. The firm’s investment framework across all target markets is anchored in institutional discipline, prioritizing attractive entry valuations, rigorous structural downside protection, and active value creation through strategic asset repositioning and operational enhancements.In parallel, DGCP announced the appointment of Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of Dar Global PLC, as Chairman of DGCP, reinforcing governance and alignment between the parent group’s international development footprint and the asset management platform. The appointment follows a transformational phase for Dar Global, which recently upgraded to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category on the London Stock Exchange and expanded its global portfolio to $23 billion in Gross Development Value (GDV).“Through Dar Global, we built an international platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities,” said Ziad El Chaar, Chairman of Dar Global Capital Partners and CEO of Dar Global. “With DGCP, we are taking the natural next step by establishing an institutional-grade, regulated vehicle that enables investors to access compelling cross-border real estate investments through a disciplined, value-oriented framework. While we pursue acquisitions across leading global gateway cities, Dubai’s exceptional fundamentals offer strong potential for targeted capital deployment.” DGCP provides specialized asset management and advisory capabilities designed to create long-term value for sovereign, institutional, and ultra-high-net-worth investors across international jurisdictions.Share ALL ARTICLES.

Dar Global continues to provide global investors with a structured gateway to high-yielding, lifestyle-driven assets in the GCC.”The destination offers buyers a rare opportunity to secure a residence within one of Qatar’s most ambitious new waterfront masterplans at an early stage. title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
text: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln30/09/2026Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK.Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%). EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million). Growth was primarily anchored by revenue recognition from landmark projects, including The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin and Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad.The Group’s Gross Development Value (GDV) nearly doubled year-on-year to reach US$23.0 billion, reflecting rapid portfolio expansion. Cumulative contracted sales rose to US$3.9 billion across 4,380 units. Dar Global maintained a robust balance sheet with a Net Asset Value of US$613.3 million and total cash balances of US$847.9 million (comprising US$231.6 million free cash and US$616.3 million restricted escrow), supporting total available liquidity of US$579.3 million.Operational momentum accelerated in Saudi Arabia with major project launches. In January, the Group partnered with The Trump Organization to launch Rayana, a 2.6 million sq. m gated community in Diriyah featuring luxury mansions and a championship golf course, followed by a SAR 338 million (~US$90 million) infrastructure contract award to Compass and Bin Omairah Company. Dar Global also unveiled Trump Plaza Jeddah (GDV US$383.6 million) and the adjacent Padel Living Residences (GDV US$142 million) within the Amaya masterplan.Capital management and project execution remained key focus areas. In April, the Group strengthened its financial flexibility by closing a US$250 million syndicated term loan facility. Following the period in August, Dar Global appointed Gulf Asia Contracting to execute podium construction for the 80-storey, ~350-metre Trump International Hotel & Tower on Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road.Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive, commented: “We have delivered a resilient performance through uncertain times in the region, supported by the quality of our international portfolio. Buyer demand across our markets remained robust, with cumulative contracted sales at 30 June 2026 of c. US$3.9 billion (Dec 2025 c. US$ 3.2 billion). During the period we closed our US$250 million facility, further strengthening our balance sheet and liquidity. Looking ahead, we remain focused on growing our Gross Development Value across both existing and new growth markets, while maintaining a disciplined focus on execution and delivery. With a strong balance sheet, disciplined capital management and a healthy project pipeline, Dar Global is well positioned to continue creating long-term value for its stakeholders.”Share ALL ARTICLES.

title: Dar Global Appoints Gulf Asia for Trump Tower Dubai
text: Dar Global appoints Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai06/08/2026DUBAI, UAEDar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded the construction contract to Gulf Asia Contracting for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. Following the successful completion of all enabling works, due in September 2026, this appointment marks the project's transition into the next stage of construction and another significant milestone in the delivery of one of Dubai's most anticipated luxury developments.Located on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, the landmark development continues to progress on schedule as construction advances into its next phase. The appointment reinforces Dar Global's commitment to partnering with leading regional contractors to deliver exceptional quality across every stage of development.Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “Following the successful completion of our enabling works, we are pleased to appoint Gulf Asia Contracting to deliver the podium construction for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. This marks another important milestone as the project continues to progress according to plan and reflects our commitment to partnering with leading contractors to deliver exceptional quality throughout every stage of development.”Introduced in April 2025, Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai is set to become a defining addition to Dubai's skyline. Rising approximately 350 metres across 80 floors, the development combines world-class hospitality, branded residences and an exclusive private members' club.Designed to set a new benchmark for luxury living, the tower will feature Dubai's highest outdoor swimming pool, two signature penthouses inspired by New York's iconic Trump Tower on Fifth Avenue, and uninterrupted views across Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai and the Arabian Gulf.The latest construction milestone reflects the continued momentum of the project as Dar Global advances the development in line with its delivery programme.Share ALL ARTICLES.

title: Dar Global & Fendi Casa Announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
text: Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman29/06/2026Muscat, OmanDar Global and FENDI Casa announce the launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the prestigious AIDA clifftop community in Muscat, Oman. Conceived by Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate company, AIDA is one of the most expansive and exclusive mixed-use real estate developments globally.The launch unveils 19 thoughtfully designed and exquisitely appointed mansions with direct beach access featuring FENDI Casa's signature Italian craftsmanship and refined high-end design to AIDA, a magnificent, gated community built on a 130-metre-high cliff, surrounded by rocky canyons, pristine beaches, and the scenic Oman coastline.Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “The launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by FENDI Casa, at AIDA reflects Dar Global’s commitment to identifying and unlocking high-value real estate opportunities in growth markets. Oman’s luxury property sector is at a turning point, fuelled by investor appetite for branded residences and government initiatives driving inbound investment. Our partnership with FENDI Casa brings world-renowned Italian design to this vision, elevating the standard of upscale living in Muscat. Together, we are further elevating the position of AIDA as a strategic gateway for global investors seeking long-term value, lifestyle returns, and design-led distinction in the region.”Positioned on an expansive site with unobstructed sea views, Azure Oceanfront Villas, with interiors by FENDI Casa, offers exceptional privacy and seclusion for a select group of discerning residents. The distinctly modern mansions embody the essence of seaside living, evoking a tranquil and luxurious sanctuary. With spacious floor plans, each villa includes private amenities such as an outdoor pool and a state-of-the-art gym. Beautifully furnished, the homes reflect FENDI Casa's renowned blend of elegance and contemporary style, with curated attention to details, materials, and artisanal craftsmanship.This elegant new landmark within AIDA marks the first collaboration between Dar Global and FENDI Casa on a high-end residential project. The unveiling also represents a significant milestone for Oman as Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by FENDI Casa, becomes the first development in the Sultanate to feature interiors by the design brand of a luxury fashion Maison.Spanning over 4.3 million sqm and targeting international investors and buyers, AIDA blends nature, luxury, and lifestyle, boasting world-class hotels, an 18-hole golf course, an exclusive members-only club, and a bouquet of residential offerings including upscale villas and apartments. Centrally located in the Omani capital, within a short distance of Muscat International Airport and Central Downtown, this significant urban development in Oman is enhancing the country's global stature as a compelling destination for tourists, residents, and investors alike.Share ALL ARTICLES.
